name: Match a sung pitch
short_description: Match a sung pitch once under stated everyday conditions without assistance.
self_assessment: I can match a sung pitch in one repeatable attempt without help.
description: Match a sung pitch means carrying out this capability under ordinary, stated conditions without another person completing any part. Practice focuses on the observable result, the threshold in the self-assessment, and repeatability across more than one occasion. The capability includes selecting an appropriate approach, completing the action, and checking the outcome. It excludes brand-specific steps, credentials, unrelated habits, and one-off achievements.
examples: Match a sung pitch in a fresh real-life scenario.

builds_on.note: Alternate hands in a simple pattern helps develop match a sung pitch but is not indispensable.
Catch a ball while moving helps develop match a sung pitch but is not indispensable.
